atomicity.reason: Two independently removable obligations are conjoined, and the title carries only one of them: dropping the 'at least every 20 ms' clause leaves a complete accuracy requirement, and dropping the error bound leaves a complete refresh-rate requirement. They are facets of the same measurement (accuracy and cadence), so this is a close pair rather than two unrelated duties - but the cadence is a separate duty the title does not advertise.
atomicity.suggestion: Split the cadence out (e.g. 'The battery management system shall refresh every cell voltage at least every 20 ms') or move it to the software-requirement stage where the sampling cycle already has a home, leaving this requirement purely the 2 mV accuracy bound.

comprehensibility.reason: Nearly self-contained - range, bound and cadence are all present - but the accuracy is qualified by the pack's operating temperature range, which a reader must bring from outside this project.
comprehensibility.suggestion: State the temperature span the 2 mV applies over inside the requirement.

feasibility.reason: 2 mV over 1.5 V to 4.5 V is comfortably inside what the stream's own supplier part delivers (SUP_AFE_MEASUREMENT_ACCURACY commits to 1.5 mV total error over -40 degC to 105 degC), so the requirement is buyable with known technology.

parent_fit.reason: Addresses the measurement arm of US_CELL_VOLTAGE_ACQUISITION substantively: 'every cell voltage measured reliably and continuously' becomes a bounded error on every cell plus a minimum refresh interval, and the story's other arm (a broken wire reported as a fault) is left to REQ_OPEN_WIRE_DETECTION.

unambiguity.reason: One reading: a total error bound of 2 mV over the stated voltage span, per cell, refreshed at least every 20 ms, with no sign, direction or plausibility caveat to reinterpret.

verifiability.reason: The error bound, the 1.5 V to 4.5 V range and the 20 ms interval are all concrete, but the qualifying condition is 'across the whole operating temperature range of the pack', which nothing in this project defines - the sweep a test would have to run is unknown.
verifiability.suggestion: Name the temperature endpoints (the supplier arm already states -40 degC to 105 degC for the front end), or cite the pack condition by reference, so the accuracy claim is executable as written.

summary: Real numbers tied to a real supplier capability, but it bundles a refresh-cadence duty the title does not mention, and its cross-temperature condition is left undefined in the project. 8/12.
